passages.text: These are the commandments and statutes and ordinances that the LORD your God has instructed me to teach you to follow in the land that you are about to enter and possess, so that you and your children and grandchildren may fear the LORD your God all the days of your lives by keeping all His statutes and commandments that I give you, and so that your days may be prolonged.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD has given me commandments, statutes, and ordinances.
The LORD has instructed me to teach you these laws.
You must do these laws in the land you are about to enter and possess.
You must keep all the LORD’s statutes and commandments that I give you.
You must do this so that you will fear the LORD your God.
You must do this all the days of your life.
Your children and your grandchildren must also keep these laws.
If you keep these laws, your days will be long.
passages.original: וְזֹ֣את הַמִּצְוָ֗ה הַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם לְלַמֵּ֣ד אֶתְכֶ֑ם לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֛ם עֹבְרִ֥ים שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃ לְמַ֨עַן תִּירָ֜א אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ לִ֠שְׁמֹר אֶת־ כָּל־ חֻקֹּתָ֣יו וּמִצְוֺתָיו֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י מְצַוֶּךָ֒ אַתָּה֙ וּבִנְךָ֣ וּבֶן־ בִּנְךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י חַיֶּ֑יךָ וּלְמַ֖עַן יַאֲרִכֻ֥ן יָמֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Hear, O Israel, and be careful to observe them, so that you may prosper and multiply greatly in a land flowing with milk and honey, just as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
passages.sermon:
Israel, listen.
Be careful to obey these commandments.
If you obey, good things will happen to you.
You will prosper.
You will become very numerous.
The LORD is the God of your fathers.
The LORD promised you this land.
This land flows with milk and honey.
passages.original: וְשָׁמַעְתָּ֤ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֣ לַעֲשׂ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ יִיטַ֣ב לְךָ֔ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר תִּרְבּ֖וּן מְאֹ֑ד כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ לָ֔ךְ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃פ

passages.text: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is One.
passages.sermon: Israel, listen.\r\nThe LORD is our God.\r\nThe LORD is One.
passages.original: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יְהוָ֥ה׀ אֶחָֽד׃

passages.text: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
You must love the LORD your God.
Love Him with all your heart.
Love Him with all your soul.
Love Him with all your strength.
passages.original: וְאָ֣הַבְתָּ֔ אֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ בְּכָל־ לְבָבְךָ֥ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשְׁךָ֖ וּבְכָל־ מְאֹדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: These words I am commanding you today are to be upon your hearts.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God gives commands today.
These commands are important.
Keep these words in your heart.
passages.original: וְהָי֞וּ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֧י מְצַוְּךָ֛ הַיּ֖וֹם עַל־ לְבָבֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: And you shall teach them diligently to your children and speak of them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road, when you lie down and when you get up.
passages.sermon:
God gave His commandments to His people.
You must teach these commandments to your children.
You must teach them carefully.
You must speak about these commandments often.
Speak about them when you sit in your house.
Speak about them when you walk on the road.
Speak about them when you lie down.
Speak about them when you get up.
passages.original: וְשִׁנַּנְתָּ֣ם לְבָנֶ֔יךָ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֖ בָּ֑ם בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֤ בְּבֵיתֶ֙ךָ֙ וּבְלֶכְתְּךָ֣ בַדֶּ֔רֶךְ וּֽבְשָׁכְבְּךָ֖ וּבְקוּמֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Tie them as reminders on your hands and bind them on your foreheads.
passages.sermon:
God gave His commandments to Israel.
\r\nGod told the people to remember His words.
\r\nTie these words as reminders on your hands.
\r\nBind these words on your foreheads.
passages.original: וּקְשַׁרְתָּ֥ם לְא֖וֹת עַל־ יָדֶ֑ךָ וְהָי֥וּ לְטֹטָפֹ֖ת בֵּ֥ין עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Write them on the doorposts of your houses and on your gates.
passages.sermon:
God gave His commandments to Israel.
God told the people to remember His words.
Write these commandments on the doorposts of your house.
Write them on your gates.
passages.original: וּכְתַבְתָּ֛ם עַל־ מְזוּזֹ֥ת בֵּיתֶ֖ךָ וּבִשְׁעָרֶֽיךָ׃ס

passages.text: And when the LORD your God brings you into the land He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, that He would give you—a land with great and splendid cities that you did not build, with houses full of every good thing with which you did not fill them, with wells that you did not dig, and with vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant—and when you eat and are satisfied, be careful not to forget the LORD who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of slavery.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD promised your fathers Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob to give you a land.
The LORD will bring you into this land.
This land has great cities.
You did not build these cities.
This land has houses full of every good thing.
You did not fill these houses.
This land has wells.
You did not dig these wells.
This land has vineyards and olive trees.
You did not plant these vineyards and olive trees.
You will eat in this land.
You will be satisfied.
Be careful.
Do not forget the LORD.
The LORD brought you out of Egypt.
Egypt was the house of slavery.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֞ה כִּ֥י יְבִיאֲךָ֣׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ אֶל־ הָאָ֜רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֧ע לַאֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ לְאַבְרָהָ֛ם לְיִצְחָ֥ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹ֖ב לָ֣תֶת לָ֑ךְ עָרִ֛ים גְּדֹלֹ֥ת וְטֹבֹ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ בָנִֽיתָ׃ וּבָ֨תִּ֜ים מְלֵאִ֣ים כָּל־ טוּב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ מִלֵּאתָ֒ וּבֹרֹ֤ת חֲצוּבִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ חָצַ֔בְתָּ כְּרָמִ֥ים וְזֵיתִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ נָטָ֑עְתָּ וְאָכַלְתָּ֖ וְשָׂבָֽעְתָּ׃ הִשָּׁ֣מֶר לְךָ֔ פֶּן־ תִּשְׁכַּ֖ח אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר הוֹצִֽיאֲךָ֛ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֥ית עֲבָדִֽים׃

passages.text: Fear the LORD your God, serve Him only, and take your oaths in His name.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is powerful and holy.
Fear the LORD your God.
Serve only the LORD your God.
Make your oaths in the name of the LORD your God.
passages.original: אֶת־ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ תִּירָ֖א וְאֹת֣וֹ תַעֲבֹ֑ד וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ׃

passages.text: Do not follow other gods, the gods of the peoples around you.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD your God.
He is with you.
Do not follow other gods.
Other gods belong to the peoples around you.
Do not go after these gods.
passages.original: לֹ֣א תֵֽלְכ֔וּן אַחֲרֵ֖י אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֑ים מֵאֱלֹהֵי֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: For the LORD your God, who is among you, is a jealous God. Otherwise the anger of the LORD your God will be kindled against you, and He will wipe you off the face of the earth.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is among you.
The LORD is a jealous God.
If you follow other gods, the LORD will become angry with you.
The LORD will destroy you from the face of the earth.
passages.original: כִּ֣י אֵ֥ל קַנָּ֛א יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בְּקִרְבֶּ֑ךָ פֶּן־ יֶ֠חֱרֶה אַף־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בָּ֔ךְ וְהִשְׁמִ֣ידְךָ֔ מֵעַ֖ל פְּנֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Do not test the LORD your God as you tested Him at Massah.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
Do not test the LORD your God.
At Massah, you tested Him.
Do not test Him as you did at Massah.
passages.original: לֹ֣א תְנַסּ֔וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר נִסִּיתֶ֖ם בַּמַּסָּֽה׃

passages.text: You are to diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God and the testimonies and statutes He has given you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He has given you commandments.
He has given you testimonies.
He has given you statutes.
You must keep all these.
You must keep them diligently.
passages.original: שָׁמ֣וֹר תִּשְׁמְר֔וּן אֶת־ מִצְוֺ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְעֵדֹתָ֥יו וְחֻקָּ֖יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: Do what is right and good in the sight of the LORD, so that it may be well with you and that you may enter and possess the good land that the LORD your God swore to give your fathers, driving out all your enemies before you, as the LORD has said.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD sees what you do.
Do what is right in the LORD’s eyes.
Do what is good in the LORD’s eyes.
If you do this, it will go well for you.
You will enter the good land.
The LORD promised this land to your fathers.
You will take this land as your own.
The LORD will drive out all your enemies before you.
The LORD said He would do this.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ הַיָּשָׁ֥ר וְהַטּ֖וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה לְמַ֙עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ וּבָ֗אתָ וְיָֽרַשְׁתָּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטֹּבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לַאֲבֹתֶֽיךָ׃ לַהֲדֹ֥ף אֶת־ כָּל־ אֹיְבֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶ֑יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: In the future, when your son asks, “What is the meaning of the decrees and statutes and ordinances that the LORD our God has commanded you?”
passages.sermon:
A son may ask his father a question in the future.
The son may say, “What do these decrees mean?”
He may ask, “What are these statutes?”
He may ask, “What are these ordinances?”
The LORD our God commanded you to keep these decrees, statutes, and ordinances.
The son wants to know the meaning of what the LORD commanded.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יִשְׁאָלְךָ֥ בִנְךָ֛ מָחָ֖ר לֵאמֹ֑ר מָ֣ה הָעֵדֹ֗ת וְהַֽחֻקִּים֙ וְהַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אֶתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: then you are to tell him, “We were slaves of Pharaoh in Egypt, but the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
passages.sermon:
We were slaves in Egypt.
Pharaoh ruled over us.
The LORD is our God.
The LORD brought us out of Egypt.
The LORD used a mighty hand to save us.
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ לְבִנְךָ֔ עֲבָדִ֛ים הָיִ֥ינוּ לְפַרְעֹ֖ה בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וַיּוֹצִיאֵ֧נוּ יְהוָ֛ה מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם בְּיָ֥ד חֲזָקָֽה׃

passages.text: Before our eyes the LORD inflicted great and devastating signs and wonders on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his household.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
The LORD acted with power.
We saw His actions with our own eyes.
The LORD sent great signs in Egypt.
The LORD sent wonders in Egypt.
These signs and wonders were terrible for Egypt.
The LORD punished Pharaoh.
The LORD punished all of Pharaoh’s household.
The LORD did these things in Egypt.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן יְהוָ֡ה אוֹתֹ֣ת וּ֠מֹפְתִים גְּדֹלִ֨ים וְרָעִ֧ים׀ בְּמִצְרַ֛יִם בְּפַרְעֹ֥ה וּבְכָל־ בֵּית֖וֹ לְעֵינֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: But He brought us out from there to lead us in and give us the land that He had sworn to our fathers.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God brought us out of Egypt.
God did this to lead us into a new land.
God promised this land to our ancestors.
God gave this land to us.
passages.original: וְאוֹתָ֖נוּ הוֹצִ֣יא מִשָּׁ֑ם לְמַ֙עַן֙ הָבִ֣יא אֹתָ֔נוּ לָ֤תֶת לָ֙נוּ֙ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִשְׁבַּ֖ע לַאֲבֹתֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: And the LORD commanded us to observe all these statutes and to fear the LORD our God, that we may always be prosperous and preserved, as we are to this day.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our God.
The LORD gave us commands.
He told us to obey all these statutes.
He told us to fear Him.
He did this for our good.
He wants us to prosper every day.
He wants us to have life, just as we do today.
passages.original: וַיְצַוֵּ֣נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַחֻקִּ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה לְיִרְאָ֖ה אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ לְט֥וֹב לָ֙נוּ֙ כָּל־ הַיָּמִ֔ים לְחַיֹּתֵ֖נוּ כְּהַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: And if we are careful to observe every one of these commandments before the LORD our God, as He has commanded us, then that will be our righteousness.”
passages.sermon:
God gave us commandments.
God is the LORD our God.
God commanded us to obey all these commandments.
We must do these commandments before God.
If we carefully obey every commandment,
God will count this as our righteousness.
passages.original: וּצְדָקָ֖ה תִּֽהְיֶה־ לָּ֑נוּ כִּֽי־ נִשְׁמֹ֨ר לַעֲשׂ֜וֹת אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֣ה הַזֹּ֗את לִפְנֵ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּֽנוּ׃ס
